construct.name: TRANSFORMATIONAL_INTELLIGENCE
construct.scope: Decision sensitivity to action-conditioned changes in future accessible transformation space

distinction_from_NEXT3.NEXT3: Tests response to a semantic representation of future transformation space assigned to an action.
distinction_from_NEXT3.current_design: Tests response to a representation of how an action changes the future accessible transformation space, beyond stable action identity and static action representation.

research_question: Does action selection respond to the represented transformation induced by an action on the future accessible transformation space, beyond stable action identity and static action representation?

operational_definition.static_representation: A representation of transformation-space properties associated with an action at the current decision state.
operational_definition.dynamic_representation: A pre-decision representation of the action-conditioned transition from the current accessible transformation space to the accessible transformation space expected after the action.
operational_definition.target_mechanism: Sensitivity of action selection to action-conditioned transformation-space change.

decision_unit.decision: Selection of one candidate action before realization of its successor state.

formal_structure.important_boundary: The realized S_{t+1}, realized T_acc and realized transformation remain unavailable to the decision agent before action selection.

dynamic_representation.purpose: Expose information about transformation of future accessible transformation space without exposing realized downstream state or outcome.

static_control.purpose: Distinguish sensitivity to a dynamic transformation-space property from sensitivity to a static semantic profile.
static_control.requirement: At least two candidate actions must be capable of receiving matched or equivalent current-state structural representations while differing in their represented action-conditioned transformation-space transition.
static_control.interpretation: A response that survives the static control is compatible with sensitivity to the dynamic property rather than merely to a static profile.

action_representation_reassignment.requirement: Dynamic transition signatures must be reassigned across action identities under balanced conditions.
action_representation_reassignment.purpose: Break stable association between action identity and dynamic representation.
action_representation_reassignment.constraint: Reassignment must preserve marginal frequencies of action identities and dynamic signatures.

DYNAMIC_INFORMATIVE.description: The visible dynamic representation corresponds to the action-conditioned transformation-space transition.

DYNAMIC_NULL.description: The visible dynamic representation preserves surface structure and marginal frequencies but is independently reassigned so that its correspondence with the action-conditioned transition is removed.

STATIC_CONTROL.description: Current-state/static structural information is controlled while the dynamic transition representation provides the distinguishing information.

SURFACE_PERMUTED.description: Representation surface structure is preserved while semantic correspondence is permuted.

visible: surface representation required by the experimental condition

primary_estimand.name: ACTION_IDENTITY_X_DYNAMIC_REPRESENTATION_INTERACTION
primary_estimand.description: Change in action-selection probability associated with reassignment of action-conditioned dynamic transformation-space representations across action identities, relative to the matched null condition.

primary_contrast.description: Compare selection under balanced reassignment of dynamic transition signatures across action identities with the matched dynamic-null condition.

identifiability_requirements: Dynamic representation must be semantically distinguishable from static representation.
Dynamic representation must describe a relation or transition between transformation spaces rather than merely another static descriptor.
Action identity and dynamic representation must be independently reassigned.
The null must remove action-to-dynamic-transition correspondence while preserving relevant surface and marginal structure.
Realized successor state and realized transformation space must remain hidden before selection.
No normative or outcome-derived signal may enter the pre-decision interface.
The implementation must permit independent reconstruction of the action-conditioned dynamic quantity.
Static-control conditions must permit separation of dynamic sensitivity from static profile preference.

interpretation_boundary.positive: Evidence that selection responds to the tested action-conditioned dynamic representation under the specified controls.
interpretation_boundary.negative: Failure to detect the specified response does not by itself falsify TGCV or establish absence of transformational intelligence in other operationalisations.

notes: This specification defines a new scientific phase and does not reopen NEXT3.
NEXT3 methodological closure and frozen fixture remain methodological foundations.
No replication count is frozen or implied by NEXT3.
No scientific execution is authorized by this artifact.
The central operational distinction is representation of a transformation of transformation space, not an additional static semantic profile.
